product_overview: BlogFusion is a multi-author blogging and engagement platform for readers, authors, and admins. It combines published article browsing and engagement with author publishing tools and admin management dashboards.
core_goals: Register for an account and sign in securely
Browse published blog posts and filter the feed by category
React to and comment on posts while logged in
Create and manage blog posts as an author or admin
Request new categories as an author
Review notifications and performance analytics as an author
Manage categories, users, and content as an admin

features.name: Authentication & Security
features.description: Lets users register, sign in, and reset their password through an OTP-based recovery flow, with role-based access control for protected areas.
user_flows: Navigate to /register -> Enter name, email, and password details -> Submit the registration form -> See account created and proceed to sign in
Navigate to /login -> Enter email and password -> Submit the login form -> See the appropriate dashboard or landing page for the signed-in role

Navigate to /login -> Select the password reset option -> Enter email address -> Request a reset code -> Receive an OTP prompt -> Enter the OTP and new password -> Submit the reset form -> See password reset success confirmation
Navigate to a protected admin or author page -> Attempt to access the page without sufficient role -> See access denied behavior and return to the login screen

features.name: Reader Platform
features.description: Allows visitors and signed-in users to browse published posts, open single articles, and engage with content through reactions and comments.
user_flows: Navigate to /home -> Browse the list of published posts -> Move through paginated results -> Open a post to read the full article
Navigate to /home -> Select a category filter -> View the feed update to matching published posts -> Open an article from the filtered list
Navigate to /single-post.php -> Open a published article -> See the article load after view tracking is processed -> Read the full content
Navigate to a post while signed in -> Submit a comment -> See the comment appear on the article discussion
Navigate to a post while signed in -> Choose an emoji reaction -> See the reaction register on the article

features.name: Author Workspace
features.description: Gives authors analytics, post feedback, category requests, and notification management tools.
user_flows: Navigate to /author/index.php -> Review author-focused statistics -> Inspect recent feedback activity
Navigate to /author/analytics.php -> View performance charts and distribution data -> Compare article output and traffic trends
Navigate to /author/request-category.php -> Enter a new category request and justification -> Submit the request -> See the request listed in the history section
Navigate to /author/notifications.php -> Review notifications -> Mark a notification as read -> Remove a notification from the list

features.name: Post Management
features.description: Allows authors and admins to create, edit, publish, search, toggle status, and delete blog posts using the rich text editor.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/posts.php -> Browse the post list -> Search for a post -> Open a post for editing -> Update the content -> Save changes -> See the post return to the list
Navigate to /admin/edit-post.php -> Enter post title, category, and rich text content -> Add media through the editor -> Save the new post -> See the post appear in the management list
Navigate to /admin/posts.php -> Find a post in the table -> Change its status between draft and published -> See the status update in the list
Navigate to /admin/posts.php -> Locate a post -> Delete the post -> See the post removed from the list

features.name: Category Management
features.description: Lets admins add, edit, and delete categories, and review or act on author category requests.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/categories.php -> Add a new category name -> Save the category -> See it appear in the category list
Navigate to /admin/categories.php -> Edit an existing category -> Update the category details -> Save changes -> See the updated category in the list
Navigate to /admin/categories.php -> Delete a category -> See the category removed from the list
Navigate to /admin/categories.php -> Review an author category request -> Take action on the request -> See the request status update

features.name: User Management
features.description: Allows admins to review system users and change their active or disabled state, along with managing roles.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/users.php -> Review the user list and roles -> Toggle a user's active state -> See the user's status update in the list
Navigate to /admin/users.php -> Locate a user account -> Change the user's role -> See the updated role displayed in the list

features.name: Admin Dashboard
features.description: Provides system-wide analytics, activity summaries, and leadership rankings for administrators.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/dashboard.php -> Review the summary counters -> Check recent activity entries -> Inspect the trend chart for site traffic
Navigate to /admin/dashboard.php -> Review author performance rankings -> Compare top authors by views -> Identify the most engaged contributors
